scope: Simulated BUY and SELL events with cash and unit replay checks
seed_rule: Version, base seed, account_id, and trade date
trade_rule: One SELL followed by one BUY per account on each trade date
quantity_rule: 1 to 5 whole units, capped by units owned or cash available
execution_rule: Same-date USD simulated price; immediate cash and unit settlement
selection_note: Buy and sell may reference the same asset; this is not a trading strategy
limitations: Trade-only scenario; excludes fees, dividends, transfers, taxes, spread, and slippage
amount_note: Trade amounts are gross values, not investment profits or household spending
